research_question: Owner-approved addition: 8 Best Legal Contract Management Software Platforms. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for legal contract management software, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
research_brief.audience: Law firm owners, legal operations staff, and legal teams in the United States.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; ContractWorks pricing corrected from $600 per month to Repository from $425 and Premium from $1,195 per month billed annually, trial corrected from two weeks of drafting to a 14-day Repository trial; ContractWorks e-signature pack price cut (not on page); Agiloft Astra free-plan claim cut (not on page); Docusign CLM Essentials and CLM+ tier names cut (not on page).
